dct_description_sm: Raw drifter data (L1 datasets) from a variety of interfaces have been collected and merged into a uniform format (L2 dataset) which is then quality-controlled, with classifications added for all locations dividing them into "Valid" (freely floating at sea), "trapped", "grounded" and  "bad". The final L3 dataset is provided here in both the form of a MATLAB binary data structure, and archival ASCII-format files.
Drifter dataset for the St Lawrence Tracer Release Experiment (TReX) Phase 1 field program (September 2020)
